comments.author: Hysocs
comments.body_html:
That mod had a lot of systems that were difficult to verify, and I personally felt much of the added complexity may not have translated into meaningful gameplay benefits.

With TraumaCore, I tried to stay focused on gameplay rather than strict realism. The bleeding system itself is not especially realistic, but it changes combat enough to make fights much more punishing. If you are not prepared to stop your bleeding quickly, you will likely die. I expect that alone may make the mod too harsh for some players, especially since trying to face-tank damage is now far more dangerous.

I’ve not used plate but from the sounds of it, it functions way differently even if on paper they are overhauls to the combat
